en.t: Edict of Thessalonica: Emperor Theodosius I and his co-emperors Gratian and Valentinian II declare their wish that all Roman citizens convert to Nicene Christianity
en.s: The Edict of Thessalonica (Greek: Διάταγμα της Θεσσαλονίκης), issued on 27 February AD 380 by Theodosius I, made Nicene Christianity the state church of the Roman Empire. It condemned other Christian creeds such as Arianism as heresies of "foolish madmen", and authorized their punishment.

zh.t: 塞萨洛尼基敕令：狄奥多西一世及其共治皇帝格拉提安和瓦伦提尼安二世宣布希望所有罗马公民皈依尼西亚基督教
zh.s: 《塞萨洛尼基敕令》（希腊语：Διάταγμα της Θεσσαλονίκης）由狄奥多西一世于公元380年2月27日颁布，使尼西亚基督教成为罗马帝国国教。敕令谴责阿里乌派等其他基督教派为“愚昧的疯子”所持的异端，并授权惩罚这些教派。

en.t: Theodosius II issues a decree organizing public teaching in Constantinople
en.s: On February 27, 425, Emperor Theodosius II issued a decree organizing publicly supported teaching in Constantinople, now Istanbul, Turkey. The institution is commonly described as the Imperial University of Constantinople; its teaching included Greek and Latin.

zh.t: 狄奥多西二世颁令在君士坦丁堡设立公立教学机构
zh.s: 425年2月27日，皇帝狄奥多西二世颁布法令，在君士坦丁堡，即今土耳其伊斯坦布尔，设立由公家支持的教学机构。该机构通常称为君士坦丁堡帝国大学，教授希腊语和拉丁语等课程。

en.t: Rival Aragonese succession factions fight at Morvedre
en.s: On February 27, 1412, supporters of Ferdinand of Antequera and James II of Urgell fought at Morvedre, now Sagunto in Spain, during the dispute over the Crown of Aragon’s succession.

zh.t: 阿拉贡王位继承派别在莫尔韦德雷交战
zh.s: 1412年2月27日，安特克拉的费尔南多与乌赫尔的海梅二世的支持者在莫尔韦德雷，即今西班牙萨贡托交战，争夺阿拉贡王位继承权。

en.s: Siege of Marienburg occurred during the Thirteen Years' War between the Teutonic Knights and the Kingdom of Poland. Marienburg was the capital of the state of the Teutonic Order, in particular, the residence of the Grand Master of the order. An alliance of Prussians and Poles besieged the city beginning 27 February 1454 with mercenaries from Danzig (Gdańsk), and the necessary artillery.

zh.s: 马林堡围城战发生在条顿骑士团与波兰王国之间的十三年战争期间。马林堡是条顿骑士团国的首都，也是骑士团大团长的驻地。1454年2月27日，普鲁士人与波兰人结盟，在来自但泽（格但斯克）的雇佣兵和火炮支援下开始围攻该城。

en.s: The Battle of Byeokjegwan was a military engagement fought in the winter of 27 February 1593, between the armies of the Ming dynasty led by Li Rusong and Japanese forces under Kobayakawa Takakage. It resulted in a Japanese victory and Ming retreat.

zh.s: 碧蹄馆之战发生于1593年2月27日冬季，是明朝李如松率领的军队与小早川隆景指挥的日军之间的一场军事交战。此战以日军获胜、明军撤退告终。

en.t: Henry IV is crowned at Chartres
en.s: On February 27, 1594, Henry IV was crowned king of France at Chartres Cathedral, France. Reims, the traditional coronation city, was then controlled by the Catholic League.

zh.t: 亨利四世在沙特尔加冕
zh.s: 1594年2月27日，亨利四世在法国沙特尔大教堂加冕。当时传统加冕地兰斯仍由天主教联盟控制。

en.s: The Treaty of Stolbovo (Russian: Столбовский мир; Swedish: Freden i Stolbova) was a peace treaty that ended the Ingrian War (Ingermanländska kriget), which had been fought between the Swedish Empire and the Russian Tsardom between 1610 and 1617.
en.n: Sweden and the Tsardom of Russia sign the Treaty of Stolbovo, ending the Ingrian War and shutting Russia out of the Baltic Sea.

zh.s: 斯托尔博沃条约（俄语：Столбовский мир；瑞典语：Freden i Stolbova）结束了瑞典帝国与俄罗斯沙皇国之间的英格里亚战争。战争从1610年持续至1617年。
zh.n: 瑞典与俄罗斯沙皇国签署《斯托尔博沃条约》，结束英格里亚战争，并使俄罗斯失去通往波罗的海的通道。

en.s: On February 27, 1626, the Ming court appointed Yuan Chonghuan governor of Liaodong after his victory at Ningyuan, giving him authority over forces outside the passes in present-day China.

zh.t: 明廷任命袁崇焕为辽东巡抚
zh.s: 1626年2月27日，明廷在宁远之战获胜后任命袁崇焕为辽东巡抚，授予他统辖关外军队的权力，相关地区位于今中国境内。

en.s: The Battle of Moore's Creek Bridge was a battle of the American Revolutionary War fought near Wilmington in present-day Pender County, North Carolina on February 27, 1776. The victory of North Carolina Revolutionary forces over Southern Loyalistshelped build political support for the revolution and increased recruitment of additional soldiers into their forces. Loyalist recruitment efforts in the interior of North Carolina began in earnest with news of the Battles of Lexington and Concord, and Patriots in the province also began organizing Continental Army and militia units.

zh.s: 1776年2月27日，美国独立战争期间，北卡罗来纳州威尔明顿附近、今彭德县境内发生穆尔溪桥战役。北卡罗来纳革命军击败南方效忠派，有助于扩大对革命的政治支持，也吸引更多人参军。此前，列克星敦与康科德战斗的消息传来后，效忠派开始在北卡罗来纳内陆大规模招募人员，爱国派也开始在该殖民地组织大陆军和民兵部队。

en.s: The Action of 27 February 1809 was a minor naval engagement during the French Revolutionary Wars. Two 44-gun frigates, Pénélope and Pauline, sortied from Toulon harbour to chase a British frigate, HMS Proserpine, which was conduction surveillance of French movements. First sneaking undetected and later trying to pass herself as a British frigate coming to relieve Proserpine, Pénélope approached within gun range before being identified. With the help of Pauline, she subdued Proserpine and forced her to surrender after a one-hour fight. Proserpine was sailed to Toulon and commissioned in the French Navy, where she served until 1865.

zh.s: 1809年2月27日，两艘各有44门炮的法国护卫舰“佩内洛普”号与“波利娜”号驶出土伦港，追击监视法军动向的英国护卫舰“普罗塞耳皮娜”号。“佩内洛普”号先悄然接近，随后伪装成前来换班的英国护卫舰，直到进入火炮射程才被认出。在“波利娜”号协助下，法舰经过一小时战斗迫使英舰投降。“普罗塞耳皮娜”号被驶往土伦，编入法国海军，服役至1865年。原文将此战列为法国大革命战争中的小规模海战。

en.s: The Battle of Bar-sur-Aube was fought on 27 February 1814, between the First French Empire and the Austrian Empire. The French were led by Jacques MacDonald, while the Austrians and their Bavarian allies, forming the Army of Bohemia, were led by Karl Philipp Fürst zu Schwarzenberg. The Austrians were victorious.

zh.s: 1814年2月27日，法兰西第一帝国与奥地利帝国在奥布河畔巴尔交战。法军由雅克·麦克唐纳指挥，奥军及巴伐利亚盟军组成的波希米亚军团，由卡尔·菲利普·施瓦岑贝格亲王指挥。奥军最终获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Tarqui, also known as the Battle of Portete de Tarqui, took place on February 27, 1829 at Portete de Tarqui, near Cuenca, Ecuador. It was fought between troops from Gran Colombia, commanded by Antonio José de Sucre, and Peruvian troops under José de La Mar. It was a victory for Gran Colombia. After winning independence from Spain, the countries that are now Ecuador, Colombia and Venezuela formed a single nation known as Gran Colombia. Simón Bolívar, the liberator of most of the Andean countries in South America had hoped to join what is now Peru and Bolivia to Gran Colombia, but Peru (including what is now parts of Bolivia) chose to remain a separate nation.

zh.s: 1829年2月27日，大哥伦比亚军与秘鲁军在厄瓜多尔昆卡附近的塔尔基山口交战，史称塔尔基战役或塔尔基山口战役。安东尼奥·何塞·德苏克雷指挥的大哥伦比亚军，击败何塞·德拉马尔率领的秘鲁部队。脱离西班牙独立后，今厄瓜多尔、哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉组成大哥伦比亚共和国。解放了南美多数安第斯国家的西蒙·玻利瓦尔，希望今秘鲁及玻利维亚也加入，但秘鲁，包括当时属其部分地区的今玻利维亚领土，选择保持独立国家地位。

en.s: The Battle of San Patricio was fought on February 27, 1836, between Texian rebels and the Mexican army, during the Texas Revolution. The battle occurred as a result of the outgrowth of the Texian Matamoros Expedition. The battle marked the start of the Goliad Campaign, the Mexican offensive to retake the Texas Gulf Coast. It took place in and around San Patricio.

zh.s: 1836年2月27日，得克萨斯革命期间，得克萨斯叛军与墨西哥军队在圣帕特里西奥交战。这场战斗由得克萨斯人马塔莫罗斯远征行动引发，并标志着戈利亚德战役的开始。墨西哥军队在这场攻势中试图夺回得克萨斯湾沿岸地区，战斗发生在圣帕特里西奥镇及周边。

en.s: The Dominican War of Independence (Spanish: Guerra de Independencia Dominicana) was a war of independence that began when the Dominican Republic declared independence from the Republic of Haiti on February 27, 1844 and ended on January 24, 1856. Before the war, the island of Hispaniola had been united for 22 years when the newly independent nation, previously known as the Captaincy General of Santo Domingo, was unified with the Republic of Haiti in 1822.

en.s: The trial of Daniel Sickles was an American criminal trial. It was the first time that a defense of "temporary insanity" was used in American law, and it was one of the most controversial trials of the 19th century. Daniel Sickles was a U.S. representative from the State of New York, and Philip Barton Key II was the U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia. On 27 February 1859, Sickles, after learning that Key was having an affair with his wife, Teresa, approached Key in Lafayette Square and shot and killed him.

en.s: The First Battle of Dalton was a series of American Civil War skirmishes that took place between February 22 and February 27, 1864, in Whitfield County, Georgia. At the suggestion of Union Major General Ulysses S. Grant, Major General George H. Thomas, decided to probe General Joseph E. Johnston's strength, to determine if the loss of two divisions to reinforce Confederate forces elsewhere had made the Confederate Army of Tennessee vulnerable to attack. On February 22, Thomas began the reconnaissance movement, which included three columns of Union troops. After several days of intense skirmishing, Thomas's army withdrew upon realizing Johnston could repel any assault.

zh.s: 1864年2月22日至27日，美国南北战争期间，佐治亚州惠特菲尔德县发生一系列交战，史称第一次道尔顿战役。在联邦军尤利西斯·S.格兰特少将建议下，乔治·H.托马斯少将决定试探约瑟夫·E.约翰斯顿将军的实力，判断邦联田纳西军调出两个师支援其他地区后，是否已容易遭受攻击。2月22日，托马斯派三路部队展开侦察。数日激战后，他意识到约翰斯顿仍能击退任何进攻，于是撤军。

en.s: The Battle of San Juan Bautista was a battle in the French intervention in Mexico fought on 27 February 1864. Mexican Republicans were victorious and retook control of the city. The Republican forces consisted only of the Tabasquian militia from the surrounding areas ranging between 300 and 1,100 men, only half of whom were equipped with firearms the others fought with machetes. San Juan Bautista, Capital of Tabasco was seized by the Imperialist forces on the 13 June 1863 by General Marin Dating from December 2, 1863 the Republican forces started attacking the state capital from several points.

en.s: The Battle of Majuba Hill (near Volksrust, South Africa) on 27 February 1881 was the main and decisive battle of the First Boer War. It was a resounding victory for the Boers and the battle is considered to have been one of the most humiliating defeats of British arms in history. Major-General Sir George Pomeroy Colley occupied the summit of the hill on the night of 26–27 February 1881. His motive for occupying the hill remains unclear. The Boers believed that he may have been attempting to outflank their positions at Laing's Nek.

zh.s: 1881年2月27日，南非福尔克斯勒斯特附近发生马朱巴山战役，这是第一次布尔战争最主要、最具决定性的一战。布尔人取得重大胜利，这场战役被认为是英国军事史上最耻辱的败仗之一。乔治·波默罗伊·科利少将爵士于2月26日至27日夜间占据山顶，其目的至今不明。布尔人认为，他可能想绕过他们在莱恩隘口的阵地。

en.s: Ontario general election, 1883 was the fifth general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on February 27, 1883, to elect the 88 Members of the 5th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Oliver Mowat, won a fourth consecutive term in government, despite losing nine seats in the Legislature. The Ontario Conservative Party, led by William Ralph Meredith, won eight additional seats.

zh.s: 1883年2月27日，加拿大安大略省举行第五次大选，选出第五届省议会88名议员。奥利弗·莫厄特领导的安大略自由党虽减少9席，仍连续第四次赢得执政权。威廉·拉尔夫·梅雷迪思领导的安大略保守党增加8席。

en.t: George I of Greece survives an assassination attempt
en.s: On February 27, 1898, King George I of Greece and his daughter Maria survived an assassination attempt while returning from Phaleron, Greece, in an open carriage. Their coachman and a horse were wounded.

zh.t: 希腊国王乔治一世遭暗杀未遂
zh.s: 1898年2月27日，希腊国王乔治一世与女儿玛丽亚从希腊法利隆乘敞篷马车返回途中遭到枪击，两人均未受伤，车夫和一匹马受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Paardeberg or Perdeberg ("Horse Mountain", 18–27 February 1900) was a major battle during the Second Anglo-Boer War. It was fought near Paardeberg Drift on the banks of the Modder River in the Orange Free State near Kimberley (now in Letsemeng Local Municipality, Free State). Lord Methuen advanced up the railway line in November 1899 with the objective of relieving the Siege of Kimberley (and the town of Mafeking, also under siege).

zh.s: 帕尔德贝格之战（又称佩尔德贝格之战；Perdeberg意为“马山”）发生于1900年2月18日至27日，是第二次布尔战争中的一场重要战役。战斗地点在奥兰治自由邦的帕尔德贝格渡口附近，位于莫德河岸边、金伯利附近（现属自由州莱塞梅地方自治市）。1899年11月，梅休因勋爵沿铁路线推进，目的是解救遭围困的金伯利镇和马弗京镇。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是源信息框所列事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Tugela (or Thukela) Heights, also known as the Battle of Pieters Hill, Battle of the Pieters, or the Battle of the Tugela River, consisted of a series of military actions lasting from 14 February through to 27 February 1900 in which General Sir Redvers Buller's British army forced Louis Botha's Boer army to lift the Siege of Ladysmith during the Second Boer War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 图盖拉（或图凯拉）高地之战又称彼得斯山之战、彼得斯之战或图盖拉河之战，是一系列军事行动，发生于1900年2月14日至27日。红弗斯·布勒爵士将军率领的英军迫使路易斯·博塔率领的布尔军解除对莱迪史密斯的围困；这场战斗属于第二次布尔战争。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是源信息框所列事件结束日期。

en.t: The Labour Representation Committee is formed in London
en.s: On February 27, 1900, trade unionists and socialist groups formed the Labour Representation Committee in London, United Kingdom, to promote working-class representation in parliament. It later became the Labour Party.

zh.t: 劳工代表委员会在伦敦成立
zh.s: 1900年2月27日，工会人士与社会主义团体在英国伦敦成立劳工代表委员会，推动工人阶级在议会中获得代表席位。该组织后来成为工党。

en.s: On February 27, 1900, eleven footballers led by Franz John founded Bayern Munich in Munich, Germany, after leaving the MTV 1879 gymnastics club.

zh.t: 拜仁慕尼黑俱乐部成立
zh.s: 1900年2月27日，弗朗茨·约翰带领11名足球运动员离开MTV 1879体操俱乐部，在德国慕尼黑成立拜仁慕尼黑俱乐部。

en.t: British forces defeat Kano troops at Kwatarkwashi
en.s: On February 27, 1903, British-led forces defeated troops of the Kano Emirate at Kwatarkwashi, in present-day Nigeria, during the conquest of the Sokoto Caliphate.

zh.t: 英国统率的军队在夸塔夸希击败卡诺军队
zh.s: 1903年2月27日，英国统率的军队在今尼日利亚夸塔夸希击败卡诺酋长国军队。这是英国征服索科托哈里发国期间的一场战斗。

en.s: The February 1906 City of London by-election was a parliamentary by-election held on 27 February 1906 for the British House of Commons constituency of City of London, which covered the "Square Mile" which was the United Kingdom's traditional financial district. The seat had become vacant on the resignation of Alban Gibbs, one of the constituency's two Conservative Members of Parliament (MPs).

zh.s: 1906年2月27日，英国下议院伦敦城选区举行补选。该选区涵盖俗称“一平方英里”的英国传统金融区。该区两名保守党议员之一阿尔班·吉布斯辞职，导致议席空缺。

en.t: The P&O liner Maloja strikes a mine off Dover
en.s: On February 27, 1916, the P&O passenger liner Maloja struck a mine off Dover, United Kingdom, and sank during the First World War. The ship had been sailing from Tilbury to Bombay, now Mumbai.

zh.t: “马洛亚”号客轮在多佛外海触雷沉没
zh.s: 1916年2月27日，英国铁行轮船公司的“马洛亚”号客轮在英国多佛外海触雷沉没。当时正值第一次世界大战，该船原定从蒂尔伯里驶往孟买。

en.t: Socialist parties establish the International Working Union in Vienna
en.s: On February 27, 1921, ten socialist parties founded the International Working Union of Socialist Parties at a conference in Vienna, Austria. The organization became known as the “Two-and-a-Half International”.

zh.t: 社会党派在维也纳成立“第二半国际”
zh.s: 1921年2月27日，十个社会党派在奥地利维也纳的一次会议上成立社会党国际工人联合会，即通常所称的“第二半国际”。

en.t: The US Supreme Court upholds the Nineteenth Amendment
en.s: On February 27, 1922, the United States Supreme Court unanimously upheld the validity of the Nineteenth Amendment in Leser v. Garnett. The amendment prohibits denying voting rights on the basis of sex; its ratification had occurred in 1920.

zh.t: 美国最高法院确认第十九修正案有效
zh.s: 1922年2月27日，美国最高法院在“莱瑟诉加内特案”中一致确认宪法第十九修正案有效。该修正案禁止因性别剥夺投票权，早在1920年已完成批准程序。

en.s: The Walsall by-election of 1925 was held on 27 February 1925. The by-election was held due to the disqualification of the incumbent Unionist MP, William Preston. It was retained by Preston.

zh.s: 1925年2月27日，英国沃尔索尔选区举行补选，原因是现任统一党议员威廉·普雷斯顿被取消议员资格。普雷斯顿在补选中重新当选，保住议席。

en.s: The Mäntsälä rebellion (Finnish: Mäntsälän kapina) was a failed coup attempt by the Lapua Movement to overthrow the Finnish government. On February 27, 1932 some 400 armed members of the Suojeluskunta militia interrupted a meeting of Social Democrats in Mäntsälä with small arms fire. This was a local event organized by the local chapter, but the national organization soon joined in. In the next few days, leading members of the Lapua Movement (Lapuanliike) and hundreds of armed members of Suojeluskunta arrived at Mäntsälä. The former Chief of General Staff, Major General Wallenius also joined the leadership of the rebellion.

zh.s: 曼采莱叛乱是拉普阿运动企图推翻芬兰政府的一次未遂政变。1932年2月27日，约400名武装的保卫军民兵在曼采莱开枪，打断社会民主党人的集会。最初这只是当地分部组织的行动，但全国组织很快加入。此后数日，拉普阿运动主要成员及数百名武装民兵来到曼采莱，前总参谋长瓦莱纽斯少将也加入叛乱领导层。

en.s: The Reichstag fire (German: Reichstagsbrand, pronounced [ˈʁaɪçstaːksˌbʁant] ) was an arson attack on the Reichstag building, home of the German parliament in Berlin, on Monday, 27 February 1933, precisely four weeks after Adolf Hitler was sworn in as Chancellor of Germany.

zh.s: 1933年2月27日星期一，位于柏林、作为德国议会所在地的国会大厦遭纵火。此时距离阿道夫·希特勒宣誓就任德国总理，恰好四周。

en.s: The Battle of Jarama (6–27 February 1937) was an attempt by General Francisco Franco's Nationalists to dislodge the Republican lines along the river Jarama, just east of Madrid, during the Spanish Civil War. Elite Spanish Legionnaires and Moroccan Regulares from the Army of Africa forced back the Republican Army of the Centre, including the International Brigades, but after days of fierce fighting no breakthrough was achieved.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 哈拉马河之战发生于1937年2月6日至27日，是弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥领导的国民军试图突破马德里以东哈拉马河沿岸共和军防线的一次行动，发生在西班牙内战期间。西班牙外籍军团精锐部队和非洲军团的摩洛哥正规军击退了包括国际纵队在内的共和军中央军团，但经过数日激战，仍未能突破防线。

en.t: The US Supreme Court rules on reinstatement after the Fansteel sit-down strike
en.s: On February 27, 1939, the United States Supreme Court ruled in NLRB v. Fansteel Metallurgical Corp. that the National Labor Relations Board could not order reinstatement of workers discharged for unlawfully occupying the employer’s property during a sit-down strike, even though the employer had also violated labour law.

zh.t: 美国最高法院就范斯蒂尔静坐罢工后的复职问题作出裁决
zh.s: 1939年2月27日，美国最高法院在范斯蒂尔冶金公司案中裁定，劳资关系委员会无权要求雇主让因静坐罢工中非法占据厂房而被解雇的工人复职，即使雇主也曾违反劳动法。

en.t: Martin Kamen and Sam Ruben discover carbon-14
en.s: Martin David Kamen (August 27, 1913 – August 31, 2002) was an American chemist who, together with Sam Ruben, co-discovered the synthesis of the isotope carbon-14 on February 27, 1940, at the University of California Radiation Laboratory, Berkeley. He also confirmed that all of the oxygen released in photosynthesis comes from water, not carbon dioxide, in 1941.

zh.t: 马丁·卡门和萨姆·鲁本发现碳-14
zh.s: 马丁·大卫·卡门（1913年8月27日—2002年8月31日）是美国化学家。1940年2月27日，他与萨姆·鲁本在加州大学伯克利分校辐射实验室共同发现了碳-14同位素的合成方法。1941年，他还证实光合作用释放的氧全部来自水，而非二氧化碳。

en.s: The Action of 27 February 1941 was a single ship action between the New Zealand crewed British cruiser HMS Leander and the Italian ship Ramb I, an auxiliary cruiser. It began when Leander ordered an un-flagged freighter to stop for an inspection. The freighter raised the Italian colours and engaged Leander which sank Ramb I shortly after.

zh.s: 1941年2月27日海战是由新西兰船员组成的英国巡洋舰“利安德”号与意大利辅助巡洋舰“兰比一世”号之间的一次单舰交战。战斗始于“利安德”号要求一艘未悬挂旗帜的货船停下接受检查。货船随后升起意大利国旗并向“利安德”号开火；“利安德”号不久后击沉了“兰比一世”号。

en.s: Operation Biting, also known as the Bruneval Raid, was a British Combined Operations raid on a German coastal radar installation at Bruneval in northern France, during the Second World War, on the night of 27–28 February 1942. Several of these installations were identified from Royal Air Force (RAF) aerial reconnaissance photographs during 1941, but the purpose and the nature of the equipment was not known.

zh.s: 咬击行动又称布吕讷瓦尔突袭，是第二次世界大战期间英国联合行动司令部对法国北部布吕讷瓦尔一处德国海岸雷达设施发动的突袭，发生在1942年2月27日至28日夜间。英国皇家空军（RAF）在1941年的空中侦察照片中发现了数处这类设施，但当时并不清楚其用途及设备性质。

en.s: The Battle of the Java Sea (Indonesian: Pertempuran Laut Jawa, Japanese: スラバヤ沖海戦, romanized: Surabaya oki kaisen, lit. 'Sea Battle off Surabaya') was a decisive naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II. Allied naval forces suffered a decisive defeat at the hands of the Imperial Japanese Navy on 27 February 1942.

zh.s: 爪哇海海战（印度尼西亚语：Pertempuran Laut Jawa；日语：スラバヤ沖海戦，罗马字：Surabaya oki kaisen，意为“泗水近海海战”）是第二次世界大战太平洋战场上的一场关键海战。1942年2月27日，盟军海军遭日本帝国海军重创。

en.s: The Smith Mine disaster was the worst coal mining disaster in the State of Montana, and the 43rd worst in the United States, according to the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH). On February 27, 1943, at approximately 9:37 a.m., an explosion ripped through Smith Mine No. 3, a coal mine located between the towns of Bearcreek and Washoe. Since it was a Saturday, there was a short crew in the mine. Of the 77 men working that day, only three got out of the mine alive, and one of the rescue workers died soon afterwards.

zh.s: 据美国国家职业安全卫生研究所统计，史密斯煤矿矿难是蒙大拿州最严重、美国第43严重的煤矿灾难。1943年2月27日早晨约9时37分，位于贝尔克里克与沃肖两镇之间的史密斯三号矿发生爆炸。当天是星期六，井下人员较少，但77名工人中只有3人生还出井，一名救援人员也在不久后死亡。

en.t: A cigarette confiscation incident sparks confrontation in Taipei
en.s: On February 27, 1947, monopoly enforcement agents in Taipei, Taiwan, confiscated cigarettes from vendor Lin Jiang-mai and struck her with a gun butt. As a crowd confronted them, an agent fired and wounded a bystander who died the following day. The incident preceded the February 28 uprising.

zh.t: 台北查缉私烟引发冲突
zh.s: 1947年2月27日，台湾台北的专卖查缉人员没收摊贩林江迈的香烟，并用枪托殴打她。围观民众上前抗议，一名查缉人员开枪击伤路人，伤者于次日死亡。这场冲突成为二二八事件的导火线。

en.t: The US Constitution’s presidential term-limit amendment is ratified
en.s: On February 27, 1951, Minnesota’s ratification completed the approval process for the Twenty-second Amendment to the United States Constitution. It generally limits a person to being elected president twice, with additional rules for partial terms served after succeeding another president.

zh.t: 美国宪法总统任期限制修正案完成批准程序
zh.s: 1951年2月27日，明尼苏达州批准美国宪法第二十二修正案，使其完成所需批准程序。修正案原则上规定一人最多两次当选总统，并对接任他人剩余任期的情况另作限制。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 27 February 1955. The result was a victory for the Japan Democratic Party, which won 185 of the 467 seats. Voter turnout was 75.8%. On 15 November 1955, the Japan Democratic Party and the Liberal Party combined as the modern Liberal Democratic Party, which ruled Japan for more than a half century. The Rightist Socialist Party of Japan and the Leftist Socialist Party of Japan also merged to form the Social Democratic Party of Japan, which was Japan's largest opposition party in the 1955 system.

zh.s: 日本于1955年2月27日举行大选，日本民主党在467个议席中赢得185席，取得胜利。投票率为75.8%。同年11月15日，日本民主党与自由党合并为自由民主党，此后执政超过半个世纪。日本社会党的左、右两派也合并，原文将合并后的政党称为日本社会民主党，称其为“五五年体制”下最大的反对党。

en.s: On 27 February 1962, the Independence Palace in Saigon, South Vietnam, was bombed by two dissident Republic of Vietnam Air Force pilots, Second Lieutenant Nguyễn Văn Cử and First Lieutenant Phạm Phú Quốc. The pilots targeted the building, the official residence of the President of South Vietnam, with the aim of assassinating President Ngô Đình Diệm and his immediate family, who acted as political advisors.

zh.s: 1962年2月27日，西贡（南越）的独立宫遭到两名叛离越南共和国空军的飞行员轰炸，二人分别是少尉阮文举和中尉范富国。他们袭击了这座南越总统官邸，意图刺杀总统吴廷琰及其作为政治顾问的直系家人。

en.t: North Vietnamese forces shell Con Thien and Gio Linh
en.s: On February 27, 1967, North Vietnamese forces fired mortars, rockets and artillery at Con Thien and Gio Linh in present-day Vietnam, following US Marine artillery fire into and north of the demilitarized zone.

zh.t: 北越军队炮击昆山与由灵据点
zh.s: 1967年2月27日，在美军海军陆战队向非军事区及其以北地区开炮后，北越军队以迫击炮、火箭弹和火炮攻击今越南境内的昆山与由灵据点。

en.s: The 1971 Football League Cup final took place on 27 February 1971 at Wembley Stadium. It was the eleventh Football League Cup final and the fifth to be played at Wembley. It was contested between Tottenham Hotspur and Aston Villa.

zh.s: 1971年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于1971年2月27日在温布利球场举行。这是第11届联赛杯决赛，也是第5次在温布利举行，由托特纳姆热刺对阵阿斯顿维拉。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in South Korea on 27 February 1973. The result was a victory for the ruling Democratic Republican Party, which won 73 of the 146 elected seats in the National Assembly. With one-thirds of seats appointed by the president, the ruling party had a Supermajority. Voter turnout was 72.9%.

zh.s: 韩国于1973年2月27日举行国会选举。执政的民主共和党在146个民选议席中赢得73席。另有三分之一议席由总统任命，使执政党取得压倒性多数。投票率为72.9%。

en.t: The Polisario Front proclaims the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic
en.s: On February 27, 1976, the Polisario Front proclaimed the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic at Bir Lehlou in Western Sahara. The declaration followed Spain’s withdrawal from the disputed territory.

zh.t: 波利萨里奥阵线宣布成立阿拉伯撒哈拉民主共和国
zh.s: 1976年2月27日，波利萨里奥阵线在西撒哈拉比尔莱赫卢宣布成立阿拉伯撒哈拉民主共和国。此时西班牙正退出这片存在主权争议的领土。

en.s: General elections were held in Western Samoa on 27 February 1982. The Human Rights Protection Party won 22 of the 47 seats in the Legislative Assembly and was able to form a government after three independents voted for its leader, Va'ai Kolone, in the vote for prime minister.

zh.s: 西萨摩亚于1982年2月27日举行大选。人权保护党在立法议会47席中赢得22席。三名独立议员在总理选举中支持该党领袖瓦艾·科洛内，使该党得以组建政府。

en.s: General elections were held in Senegal on 27 February 1983 to elect a President and National Assembly. Incumbent Abdou Diouf, who had taken office in January 1981 following the resignation of Léopold Sédar Senghor, defeated four other candidates in the presidential election. In the National Assembly election Diouf's Socialist Party won 111 of the 120 seats. Voter turnout was 56.2% in the Assembly election and 56.7% in the presidential election.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于1983年2月27日举行总统及国民议会选举。利奥波德·塞达尔·桑戈尔辞职后，阿卜杜·迪乌夫于1981年1月接任总统，这次击败另外四名候选人。迪乌夫的社会党在国民议会120席中赢得111席。议会选举投票率为56.2%，总统选举为56.7%。

en.s: The 1986 Iraqi Perseverance Cup (Arabic: كأس المثابرة العراقي 1986) was the 1st edition of the Iraqi Super Cup. The match was contested between the 1985–86 Iraqi National League winners and runners-up respectively, Al-Talaba and Al-Rasheed, at Al-Rasheed Stadium in Baghdad. It was played on 27 February 1986 to bring an end to the 1985–86 season. Al-Rasheed won the game 2–1.

zh.s: 1986年伊拉克坚毅杯（阿拉伯语：كأس المثابرة العراقي 1986）是首届伊拉克超级杯。比赛于1986年2月27日在巴格达的拉希德体育场举行，由1985—86赛季伊拉克全国联赛冠军阿尔塔拉巴队对阵亚军阿尔拉希德队。阿尔拉希德以2比1获胜，为1985—86赛季画上句号。

en.t: Bihar votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 27, 1990, Bihar, India, held its legislative assembly election. Janata Dal emerged victorious, and Lalu Prasad Yadav subsequently became chief minister.

zh.s: 1990年2月27日，印度比哈尔邦举行议会选举。人民党（Janata Dal）获胜，拉卢·普拉萨德·亚达夫随后出任首席部长。

en.t: Pondicherry votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 27, 1990, Pondicherry, now Puducherry in India, held its legislative assembly election for 30 constituencies. M. D. R. Ramachandran of the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam subsequently became chief minister.

zh.s: 1990年2月27日，印度本地治里举行议会选举，选出30个选区的议员。达罗毗荼进步联盟的M. D. R.拉马钱德兰随后出任首席部长。

en.t: Orissa votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 27, 1990, Orissa, now Odisha in India, held its legislative assembly election for 147 constituencies.

zh.t: 奥里萨邦举行议会选举

en.t: Rajasthan votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 27, 1990, Rajasthan, India, held its legislative assembly election for 200 constituencies. The Bharatiya Janata Party won the most seats, and Bhairon Singh Shekhawat subsequently became chief minister.

zh.t: 拉贾斯坦邦举行议会选举
zh.s: 1990年2月27日，印度拉贾斯坦邦举行议会选举，选出200个选区的议员。印度人民党赢得最多席位，拜龙·辛格·谢卡瓦特随后出任首席部长。

en.t: Gujarat votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 27, 1990, Gujarat, India, held its legislative assembly election. No party won a majority; Janata Dal and the Bharatiya Janata Party later formed a coalition government.

zh.t: 古吉拉特邦举行议会选举
zh.s: 1990年2月27日，印度古吉拉特邦举行议会选举。没有政党单独过半，人民党（Janata Dal）与印度人民党随后组建联合政府。

en.s: On February 27, 1990, Maharashtra, India, held its legislative assembly election to elect 288 members.

zh.s: 1990年2月27日，印度马哈拉施特拉邦举行议会选举，选出288名议员。

en.t: Madhya Pradesh votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 27, 1990, Madhya Pradesh, India, held its legislative assembly election. The Bharatiya Janata Party won a majority, and Sunderlal Patwa subsequently became chief minister.

zh.s: 1990年2月27日，印度中央邦举行议会选举。印度人民党赢得多数席位，孙德尔拉尔·帕特瓦随后出任首席部长。

en.t: Himachal Pradesh votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 27, 1990, Himachal Pradesh, India, held its legislative assembly election. The Bharatiya Janata Party won a majority, and Shanta Kumar subsequently became chief minister.

zh.t: 喜马偕尔邦举行议会选举
zh.s: 1990年2月27日，印度喜马偕尔邦举行议会选举。印度人民党赢得多数席位，尚塔·库马尔随后出任首席部长。

en.s: The Battle of Medina Ridge was a tank battle fought on February 27, 1991, during the Gulf War, between the U.S. 1st Armored Division and the 2nd Brigade of the Iraqi Republican Guard Medina Luminous Division outside Basra, Iraq. The U.S. 3rd Brigade, 3rd Infantry Division was also a major contributor. Iraq's Adnan Motorized Division was also a participant. Iraq's Medina Ridge is the name American troops gave to a low rise, approximately seven miles (11 km) long. The battle, which was waged over approximately two hours, was the largest tank battle of the war and the largest tank battle in American history.

zh.s: 1991年2月27日，海湾战争期间，美国第一装甲师与伊拉克共和国卫队麦地那光辉师第二旅，在伊拉克巴士拉城外进行坦克战。美军第三步兵师第三旅也发挥重要作用，伊拉克阿德南摩托化师同样参战。“麦地那山脊”是美军对当地一片低矮高地的称呼，长约7英里，即11公里。战斗持续约两小时，是这场战争及美国历史上规模最大的坦克战。

en.s: The Battle for Jalibah Airfield took place when the U.S. 2nd Brigade, 24th Infantry Division successfully attacked and captured the heavily defended Jalibah Southeast Air Base military airfield in Iraq, located 80 miles west of Basra, on February 27, 1991 during the Gulf War.

zh.s: 1991年2月27日，海湾战争期间，美国第24步兵师第二旅攻击并成功夺取伊拉克防守严密的贾利巴东南空军基地。该军用机场位于巴士拉以西80英里。

en.s: The Fifth National Parliamentary Elections 1991 (Bengali: পঞ্চম জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচন ১৯৯১) were held in Bangladesh on 27 February 1991. The result was a victory for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party, which won 140 of the 300 seats. Voter turnout was 55.4%.

zh.s: 孟加拉国于1991年2月27日举行第五届国民议会选举。孟加拉国民族主义党在300个议席中赢得140席，取得胜利。投票率为55.4%。

en.s: The Battle of Kuwait International Airport occurred on February 27, 1991, during the 1st Gulf War. It was a tank battle between the United States (as part of the Coalition of the Gulf War) and Iraq. Despite being a very large battle it is often overlooked compared to the other battles which took place during the war. No less than elements of 18 divisions total participated in this battle.

zh.s: 科威特国际机场之战发生于1991年2月27日，属于第一次海湾战争。这是一场美国（作为海湾战争多国联军的一员）与伊拉克之间的坦克战。尽管规模很大，这场战斗常被战争期间的其他战斗掩盖，共有至少18个师的部队参与其中。

en.t: British armour reaches its final Basra Highway objectives
en.s: On February 27, 1991, Britain’s 1st Armoured Division secured its final objectives on the Basra Highway north of Multa Ridge, Iraq, during the Gulf War ground offensive.

zh.t: 英军装甲部队抵达巴士拉公路最后目标
zh.s: 1991年2月27日，英国第1装甲师在海湾战争地面攻势中夺取伊拉克穆勒塔山脊以北、巴士拉公路沿线的最后目标。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Niger on 27 February 1993, with a second round on 27 March after no candidate passed the 50% barrier in the first round. They were the first multi-candidate presidential elections held in the country since independence in 1960, following constitutional changes approved in a referendum the previous year. Although Mamadou Tandja of the ruling National Movement for the Development of Society (which had emerged as the largest party in the parliamentary elections) won the most votes in the first round, he lost in the second round to Mahamane Ousmane of the Democratic and Social Convention party.

zh.s: 尼日尔于1993年2月27日举行总统选举，因首轮无人超过50%得票率，3月27日举行第二轮。这是该国1960年独立后首次有多名候选人的总统选举，依据前一年公投通过的宪法改革举行。执政的全国社会发展运动在议会选举中成为第一大党，其候选人马马杜·坦贾首轮得票最多，但第二轮输给民主与社会大会党的马哈曼·奥斯曼。

en.s: General elections were held in Niue on 27 February 1993. Turnout was 91%. Following the election Frank Lui was elected Premier of Niue, defeating incumbent Young Vivian 11–9. John Tofo Funaki was elected Speaker.

zh.s: 纽埃于1993年2月27日举行大选，投票率为91%。选举后，弗兰克·卢伊以11票对9票击败现任总理扬·维维安，获选为新总理。约翰·托福·富纳基当选议长。

en.s: General elections were held in Sierra Leone on 26 and 27 February 1996 to elect a president and Parliament of Sierra Leone. A second round of voting in the presidential election was held on 15 March. It was the first election since multi-party politics had been reintroduced following a referendum on a new constitution in 1991, and the first multi-party election held in the country since 1977. The parliamentary elections were won by the Sierra Leone People's Party, which returned to power after a 29-year absence. The All People's Congress, which had governed from 1968 to 1992 (from 1978 to 1991 as the sole legally permitted party) finished fourth.

zh.s: 塞拉利昂于1996年2月26日至27日举行大选，选出总统及议会，总统第二轮投票于3月15日举行。该国在1991年新宪法公投后恢复多党政治，这是恢复后的首次选举，也是自1977年以来首次多党选举。塞拉利昂人民党赢得议会选举，在离开政权29年后重新执政。1968年至1992年执政的全国人民大会党仅列第四，该党曾于1978年至1991年作为唯一合法政党统治。

en.s: A by-election was held for the United Kingdom parliament constituency of Wirral South, in Merseyside, England, on 27 February 1997. The seat became vacant on the death of Conservative Party Member of Parliament Barry Porter, and was won by Labour's Ben Chapman. The Conservative loss in this seat, which came close to the last possible date for a general election, meant that they no longer had a majority in the House of Commons. Wirral South was the last in a run of significant Conservative losses, following a period of dissatisfaction with the Major years.

zh.s: 英国英格兰默西塞德郡威勒尔南选区，于1997年2月27日举行议会补选。保守党议员巴里·波特去世，造成议席空缺，工党的本·查普曼当选。此次失利发生在大选最迟举行期限将近之时，使保守党失去下议院多数。民众长期不满梅杰执政表现，保守党接连遭遇重大补选失利，威勒尔南是这一连串失利的最后一场。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Nigeria on 27 February 1999. These were the first elections since the 1993 military coup, and the first elections of the Fourth Nigerian Republic. The result was a victory for Olusegun Obasanjo of the People's Democratic Party, who defeated Olu Falae, who was running on a joint Alliance for Democracy-All People's Party ticket. Voter turnout was 52.3%.

zh.s: 尼日利亚于1999年2月27日举行总统选举。这是1993年军事政变后的首次选举，也是尼日利亚第四共和国的首次选举。人民民主党的奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔击败民主联盟与全体人民党共同推出的奥卢·法拉埃。投票率为52.3%。

en.s: The 1999 European Challenge Cup Final was the final match of the 1998–99 European Challenge Cup, the third season of Europe's second-tier club rugby union competition. The match was played on 27 February 1999 at Stade de Gerland in Lyon. The match was contested by Bourgoin and Montferrand, who are both from France. Montferrand won the match 35–16; outscoring Bourgoin 2 tries to 1.

zh.s: 1998—99赛季欧洲挑战杯决赛，于1999年2月27日在里昂热尔兰体育场举行。这是欧洲第二级别俱乐部十五人制橄榄球赛事的第三个赛季。对阵双方布尔关与蒙费朗均来自法国，蒙费朗以35比16获胜，达阵数为2比1。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Senegal on 27 February 2000, with a second round taking place on 19 March after no candidate won over 50% of votes in the first round. Although incumbent President Abdou Diouf of the Socialist Party won the most votes in the first round, he was defeated by long-term opposition leader Abdoulaye Wade of the Senegalese Democratic Party in the second round, marking the first time that the Socialist Party and its predecessors had lost power since independence. Voter turnout was 62.2% in the first round and 60.8% in the second.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于2000年2月27日举行总统选举，因首轮无人获得超过50%的选票，3月19日进行第二轮。社会党的现任总统阿卜杜·迪乌夫虽然首轮得票最多，却在第二轮败给长期反对派领袖、塞内加尔民主党的阿卜杜拉耶·瓦德。社会党及其前身自国家独立以来首次失去政权。两轮投票率分别为62.2%和60.8%。

en.s: No Way Out (2000) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), which took place on February 27, 2000, at the Hartford Civic Center in Hartford, Connecticut. It was presented by PhoneFree.com. It was the first event produced under the No Way Out name, although it was preceded in 1998 by an event named No Way Out of Texas. The main event was a Hell in a Cell match, a match where the ring and ringside area was surrounded by a 20-foot-high roofed steel cell between WWF Champion Triple H and Cactus Jack; Triple H won the match to retain his championship.

zh.s: “无路可逃2000”是世界摔角联盟（WWF）举办、PhoneFree.com赞助的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2000年2月27日在康涅狄格州哈特福德市政中心举行。这是首次直接使用“无路可逃”名称的赛事，此前1998年曾举行“无路可逃之得克萨斯”。主赛由WWF冠军Triple H迎战仙人掌杰克，采用“地狱牢笼”规则，即擂台与周边区域被20英尺高、有顶的钢笼包围。Triple H获胜并保住冠军。

en.s: The 2000 Puerto Rico Republican presidential primary was held on February 27, 2000, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. 14 delegates to the Republican National Convention were allocated to presidential candidates. Although Puerto Rico would not participate in the 2000 presidential general election because it is a U.S. territory and not a state, it equally participated in the U.S. presidential caucuses and primaries.

zh.t: 2000年波多黎各共和党总统初选
zh.s: 波多黎各于2000年2月27日举行共和党总统初选，作为该党2000年总统候选人提名程序的一部分，向候选人分配参加全国代表大会的14名代表。波多黎各属于美国领地，并非州，因此不能参加2000年总统正式大选，但仍与其他地区一样参与总统党团会议及初选。

en.s: The 2000 Football League Cup final was played between Leicester City, in their third final appearance in four years, and First Division side Tranmere Rovers at Wembley Stadium on 27 February 2000. It was the 34th and last League Cup final to be played at the original Wembley Stadium. Leicester won 2–1 to become the last team to win the League Cup at the old Wembley.

zh.s: 2000年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于2000年2月27日在温布利球场举行，由莱斯特城对阵英格兰甲级联赛球队特兰米尔流浪者。莱斯特城此前四年内第三次闯入决赛。这是旧温布利球场举办的第34场、也是最后一场联赛杯决赛。莱斯特城以2比1获胜，成为最后一支在旧温布利捧起联赛杯的球队。

en.s: The 2000 CONCACAF Gold Cup final was a soccer match played on February 27, 2000 at the Memorial Coliseum, Los Angeles to determine the winner of the 2000 CONCACAF Gold Cup. Canada beat invitees Colombia 2–0. This was Canada's first Gold Cup title and its second major title, the first since the 1985 CONCACAF Championship. As the Gold Cup champions, Canada represented CONCACAF at the 2001 FIFA Confederations Cup in Japan.

zh.t: 2000年中北美洲及加勒比海金杯赛决赛
zh.s: 2000年中北美洲及加勒比海金杯赛决赛于2000年2月27日在洛杉矶纪念体育场举行，决出当届赛事冠军。加拿大以2比0击败受邀参赛的哥伦比亚，首次赢得金杯赛冠军，也是自1985年中北美洲锦标赛以来第二次获得重要赛事冠军。作为金杯赛冠军，加拿大代表中北美洲及加勒比海足联参加了2001年在日本举行的国际足联联合会杯。

en.s: Loganair Flight 670A (LC670A) was a scheduled cargo flight for Royal Mail from Edinburgh-Turnhouse Airport, Scotland to Belfast International Airport. On 27 February 2001, the Short 360 operating the flight ditched in the Firth of Forth off Edinburgh at around 17:30 local time; the two crewmembers' bodies were found in the wreckage a few hours after the accident.

zh.s: 洛根航空670A号班机（LC670A）是为英国皇家邮政运营的定期货运航班，从苏格兰爱丁堡特恩豪斯机场飞往贝尔法斯特国际机场。2001年2月27日，当地时间下午约5时30分，执飞的肖特360在爱丁堡外海的福斯湾迫降。事故发生数小时后，两名机组人员的遗体在残骸中被找到。

en.t: The Boao Forum for Asia is inaugurated in China
en.s: On February 27, 2001, representatives of Asian and Australasian countries established the Boao Forum for Asia in Boao, Hainan, China. The forum was created to encourage regional dialogue and cooperation.

zh.t: 博鳌亚洲论坛在海南成立
zh.s: 2001年2月27日，亚洲及澳大拉西亚国家的代表在中国海南博鳌宣布成立博鳌亚洲论坛，推动区域对话与合作。

en.t: A Ryanair aircraft is evacuated after engine smoke at Stansted
en.s: On February 27, 2002, a Ryanair Boeing 737 arriving from Dublin developed smoke from its right engine after landing at London Stansted Airport, United Kingdom. Everyone evacuated, and four passengers suffered minor injuries. Investigators found a failed engine bearing and no physical signs of fire inside the engine.

zh.t: 瑞安航空客机因发动机冒烟在斯坦斯特德机场撤离乘客
zh.s: 2002年2月27日，瑞安航空一架从都柏林抵达英国伦敦斯坦斯特德机场的波音737，在着陆后右侧发动机冒烟。机上人员全部撤离，四名乘客受轻伤。调查发现发动机轴承失效，发动机内部没有实际燃烧的痕迹。

en.s: Senate elections were held in Pakistan on 24 & 27 February 2003. All 100 seats in the Senate were up for election with half of the winning candidates serving six-year terms, and the other half serving three-year terms. In Punjab, Sindh, NWFP, and Balochistan, the election was held on 24 February, while in FATA and Islamabad, it was held on 27 February.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于2003年2月24日和27日举行参议院选举，改选全部100个议席。一半当选者任期六年，另一半任期三年。旁遮普、信德、西北边境及俾路支省在2月24日投票，联邦直辖部落地区和伊斯兰堡则在2月27日投票。

en.s: The 2005 Football League Cup final was a football match played between Liverpool and Chelsea on 27 February 2005 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. en.t: WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control
en.s: The World Health Organization Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (WHO FCTC) is a treaty adopted by the 56th World Health Assembly held in Geneva, Switzerland on 21 May 2003. It became the first World Health Organization treaty adopted under article 19 of the WHO constitution. The treaty came into force on 27 February 2005. It had been signed by 168 countries and is legally binding in 182 ratifying countries.

zh.t: 世界卫生组织《烟草控制框架公约》
zh.s: 世界卫生组织《烟草控制框架公约》（WHO FCTC）是一项条约，于2003年5月21日在瑞士日内瓦举行的第56届世界卫生大会上通过。它是世界卫生组织依据《组织法》第19条通过的首项条约。公约于2005年2月27日生效，当时已有168个国家签署，并对182个批准国具有法律约束力。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是源信息框所列生效日期。

en.t: Richard M. Daley wins a sixth Chicago mayoral term
en.s: On February 27, 2007, Richard M. Daley won the mayoral election in Chicago, United States, securing a sixth term. His challengers included Dorothy Brown and William “Dock” Walls.

zh.t: 理查德·M.戴利赢得第六届芝加哥市长任期
zh.s: 2007年2月27日，理查德·M.戴利赢得美国芝加哥市长选举，获得第六届任期。参选对手包括多萝西·布朗和威廉·“多克”·沃尔斯。

en.t: Wichita holds its mayoral primary election
en.s: On February 27, 2007, Wichita, Kansas, United States, held its mayoral primary election. The general election followed on April 3.

zh.t: 威奇托举行市长选举初选
zh.s: 2007年2月27日，美国堪萨斯州威奇托举行市长选举初选，正式选举随后于4月3日举行。

en.t: Kansas City holds its mayoral primary
en.s: On February 27, 2007, Kansas City, Missouri, held its mayoral primary. Alvin Brooks and Mark Funkhouser advanced to the March 27 general election.
en.n: This entry records the primary; the general election followed on March 27.

zh.t: 堪萨斯城举行市长初选
zh.s: 2007年2月27日，美国密苏里州堪萨斯城举行市长初选。阿尔文·布鲁克斯和马克·芬克豪泽进入3月27日的普选。

en.s: On 27 February 2010 at 03:34 UTC−03:00, a Mww 8.8 megathrust earthquake struck off the coast of the Maule Region of central Chile. One of the most powerful earthquakes ever recorded, it lasted approximately three minutes and was felt across six Chilean regions, home to roughly 80 percent of the country's population.

en.s: The 2010 Japanese Super Cup was held on 27 February 2010 between the 2009 J. League champions Kashima Antlers and the 2009 Emperor's Cup winner Gamba Osaka. The match was drawn 1–1 at the end of regulation time and Kashima Antlers went on to win the match 5–3 in penalties.

en.s: UFC 127: Penn vs. Fitch was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on Sunday, 27 February 2011 at Acer Arena in Sydney, Australia. The match was contested by Arsenal and Birmingham City, at Wembley Stadium in London, on 27 February 2011.

zh.s: 2010—11赛季英格兰联赛杯决赛，于2011年2月27日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由阿森纳对阵伯明翰城。这是第51届联赛杯的最后一场比赛，该项赛事由英超及英格兰足球联赛的92支球队参加。

en.s: The 2011 Belarusian Super Cup was held on 27 February 2011 between the 2010 Belarusian Premier League champions and 2009–10 Belarusian Cup winners BATE Borisov and the 2009–10 Belarusian Cup runners-up Torpedo-BelAZ Zhodino. BATE won the match 3–0 and defended the trophy.

zh.s: 2011年白俄罗斯超级杯于2011年2月27日举行，由2010年白俄罗斯超级联赛冠军、2009—10年白俄罗斯杯冠军鲍里索夫BATE队对阵该项赛事亚军日托米尔别拉斯队。鲍里索夫BATE以3比0获胜，成功卫冕。

en.s: A leadership spill in the Australian Labor Party, the party of government in the Parliament of Australia, was held on 27 February 2012 at 10 am AEDT, followed by a ballot. The Prime Minister, Julia Gillard, announced the spill at a press conference on 23 February 2012, following the resignation of the Minister for Foreign Affairs, Kevin Rudd, from his cabinet position after months of speculation that he intended to challenge Gillard for the leadership.

zh.s: 2012年2月27日上午10时（澳大利亚东部夏令时间），澳大利亚工党举行党魁选举，并随后投票。时任总理朱莉娅·吉拉德于2月23日在新闻发布会上宣布举行选举。此前，外交部长陆克文在数月来不断传出有意挑战吉拉德党魁地位的消息后，辞去了内阁职务。

en.s: On 27 February 2013, a gunman opened fire at the Kronospan wood-processing plant in the Swiss town of Menznau, killing four people. Five others were wounded, two critically. The gunman died during a struggle with another worker.

zh.s: 2013年2月27日，一名枪手在瑞士门茨瑙镇的克诺斯邦木材加工厂开枪，造成4人死亡、5人受伤，其中2人伤势危急。枪手在与另一名工人搏斗时死亡。

en.s: NXT Arrival (stylized as NXT arRIVAL) was a professional wrestling event produced by WWE, featuring their developmental branch NXT, that took place on February 27, 2014 at Full Sail University in Winter Park, Florida. It was a special episode of WWE NXT and the first live professional wrestling event streamed online via the WWE Network. Six professional wrestling matches took place during the event. In the main event, Bo Dallas defended the NXT Championship against Adrian Neville in a ladder match, which Neville won to become the new champion. The card also featured Paige defeating Emma to retain the NXT Women's Championship and Cesaro defeating Sami Zayn.

zh.s: “NXT降临”是WWE为旗下发展品牌NXT举办的职业摔角赛事，于2014年2月27日在佛罗里达州温特帕克的福赛大学举行。它是《WWE NXT》特别节目，也是首场通过WWE Network在线直播的职业摔角赛事，共六场比赛。主赛中，博·达拉斯在梯子赛中迎战阿德里安·内维尔，争夺NXT冠军，内维尔获胜成为新冠军。另有佩奇击败艾玛，保住NXT女子冠军，以及塞萨罗击败萨米·扎恩。

en.s: On 27 February 2014, the Crimean Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine was taken over by unmarked Russian soldiers. It was among the events that triggered the Russo-Ukrainian War and laid the foundation for Crimea's annexation three weeks later. The Prosecutor's Office of Ukraine's Autonomous Republic of Crimea described the incident as a terrorist attack.

zh.s: 2014年2月27日，没有佩戴标识的俄罗斯军人占领乌克兰克里米亚最高议会。这是引发俄乌战争的事件之一，也为三周后俄罗斯吞并克里米亚奠定基础。乌克兰克里米亚自治共和国检察机关将此事定性为恐怖袭击。

en.s: On 27 February 2015, Boris Nemtsov, a Russian politician opposed to the government of Vladimir Putin, was assassinated as he crossed the Bolshoy Moskvoretsky Bridge in central Moscow at 23:31 local time. An unknown assailant fired seven or eight shots from a Makarov pistol. Four of them hit Nemtsov in the head, heart, liver and stomach, killing him almost instantly.

zh.s: 2015年2月27日23:31（当地时间），反对弗拉基米尔·普京政府的俄罗斯政治人物鲍里斯·涅姆佐夫在莫斯科市中心穿过莫斯科河大桥时遇刺。一名身份不明的袭击者用马卡洛夫手枪开了七八枪，其中四枪击中涅姆佐夫的头部、心脏、肝脏和胃部，他几乎当场死亡。

en.s: UFC Fight Night: Silva vs. Bisping (also known as UFC Fight Night 84) was a mixed martial arts event held on February 27, 2016 at The O2 Arena in London, England.

en.s: The 2016 South Carolina Democratic presidential primary took place on February 27 in the U.S. state of South Carolina, marking the Democratic Party's fourth nominating contest in their series of presidential primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. Clinton won the South Carolina Democratic primary by a landslide margin of more than 47%, receiving a larger percentage of the African American vote than Obama, the first black President, did in 2008.

zh.t: 2016年南卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年2月27日，美国南卡罗来纳州举行民主党总统初选，这是民主党在2016年总统选举提名过程中举行的第四场初选。希拉里·克林顿以超过47个百分点的优势获胜；她在非裔选民中的得票比例高于2008年首位非裔美国总统奥巴马在该州初选中的比例。

en.s: The 2016 President's Cup was the third President's Cup contested for. The match was played between 2015 League of Ireland Premier Division champions Dundalk and 2015 FAI Cup runners-up Cork City on 27 February 2016, at Turners Cross. Cork City won the match 2-0, taking the lead in the 20th minute through Gavan Holohan and doubled the advantage in the second half through Sean Maguire’s header.

zh.s: 2016年总统杯是第三届该项赛事。比赛于2016年2月27日在特纳斯十字球场举行，由2015年爱尔兰超级联赛冠军邓多克队对阵2015年爱尔兰足协杯亚军科克城队。科克城以2比0获胜：加文·霍洛汉在第20分钟首开纪录，肖恩·马圭尔随后在下半场头球破门，扩大领先优势。

en.s: Chang'an Ford 2016 Chinese FA Super Cup (Chinese: 长安福特2016中国足球协会超级杯) was the 14th Chinese FA Super Cup. The match was played at Chongqing Olympic Sports Center on 27 February 2016, contested by Super League winners Guangzhou Evergrande Taobao and FA Cup winners Jiangsu Suning. Guangzhou Evergrande beat Jiangsu Suning 2–0, thus winning their second Chinese FA Super Cup title after losing in recent three years.

zh.s: 长安福特2016中国足球协会超级杯是第14届中国足协超级杯。比赛于2016年2月27日在重庆奥林匹克体育中心举行，由中超冠军广州恒大淘宝队对阵足协杯冠军江苏苏宁队。广州恒大以2比0击败江苏苏宁，第二次夺得中国足协超级杯；此前三年，他们连续未能夺冠。

en.t: Syrian rebels counterattack Islamic State-linked forces near Daraa
en.s: On February 27, 2017, Syrian rebel forces counterattacked Islamic State-linked fighters in southwestern Daraa, Syria. Reports said they retook two villages, but an initial claim that they had also captured Tal al-Jamou hill was contradicted by later reporting.

zh.t: 叙利亚反对派在德拉西南反攻“伊斯兰国”关联武装
zh.s: 2017年2月27日，叙利亚反对派在德拉西南反攻与“伊斯兰国”有关联的武装。报道称反对派夺回两个村庄，但最初有关同时夺取塔勒贾穆山头的说法，受到后续报道的否定。

en.s: The elections to the 13th Nagaland State Legislative Assembly was held on 27th February 2018 in 59 out of its 60 constituencies, with one member elected unopposed. The counting of votes took place on 3rd March 2018. The incumbent Naga People's Front (NPF) lost the elections, while Chief minister T. R. Zeliang retained his seat. Former NPF leader, Neiphiu Rio joined the Nationalist Democratic Progressive Party (NDPP) before the elections.

zh.s: 印度那加兰邦于2018年2月27日举行第13届邦议会选举，60个选区中59个投票，另有一名议员无竞争当选。计票于3月3日进行。执政的那加人民阵线败选，但首席部长T.R.泽良保住自己的议席。该党前领袖内菲乌·里奥在选举前加入民族民主进步党。

en.s: The Meghalaya Legislative Assembly election was held on 27 February 2018 to elect 59 of 60 members to the Meghalaya Legislative Assembly, with the results declared on 3 March. The scheduled election in Williamnagar constituency was delayed to an undetermined date following the death of Nationalist Congress Party candidate Jonathone Sangma in an IED blast in East Garo Hills district on 18 February 2018.

zh.s: 印度梅加拉亚邦于2018年2月27日举行议会选举，选出60名议员中的59名，结果于3月3日公布。民族主义大会党候选人乔纳森·桑马于2月18日在东加罗山区遭简易爆炸装置袭击身亡，威廉纳加尔选区原定的投票因此推迟，当时尚未确定新日期。

en.t: 2018 New Zealand National Party leadership election
en.s: The 2018 New Zealand National Party leadership election was held on 27 February 2018 to determine the 12th Leader of the National Party. On 13 February 2018, Bill English announced his resignation as leader of the National Party, effective on 27 February 2018. He left Parliament on 13 March 2018. On 20 February, Deputy Leader Paula Bennett announced that a concurrent deputy leadership election would take place, in which she would stand.

zh.s: 2018年2月27日，新西兰国家党举行党魁选举，以选出该党的第12任党魁。2月13日，比尔·英格利希宣布辞去党魁职务，辞职于2月27日生效；他于3月13日离开议会。2月20日，副党魁葆拉·贝内特宣布将同时举行副党魁选举，并表示自己会参选。

en.t: 2018 New Zealand First Party deputy leadership election
en.s: An election for the parliamentary Deputy leadership of the New Zealand First Party took place in the NZ First Party parliamentary caucus on 27 February 2018. Incumbent deputy leader and sitting List MP, Ron Mark was challenged for the position by fellow list MP Fletcher Tabuteau. In the election Tabuteau won the required number of votes and replaced Mark as deputy leader of the party.

zh.t: 2018年新西兰第一党副党魁选举
zh.s: 2018年2月27日，新西兰第一党议会党团举行副党魁选举。时任副党魁、议员罗恩·马克受到同为议员的弗莱彻·塔布特挑战。塔布特在选举中获得所需票数，接替马克出任副党魁。

en.s: The 2018 Alberta Party leadership election occurred on February 27, 2018. It was triggered when outgoing Alberta Party leader Greg Clark announced on November 18, 2017, that he would be resigning as soon as his successor was chosen. According to published reports, Clark was pushed out by the party's board of directors as a result of a surge of former Progressive Conservatives joining the party following the PC party's merger into the United Conservative Party.

zh.s: 2018年2月27日，阿尔伯塔党举行党魁选举。此次选举缘于时任党魁格雷格·克拉克于2017年11月18日宣布，他将在继任者选出后辞职。据媒体报道，随着前进步保守党成员在该党并入联合保守党后大批加入阿尔伯塔党，党董事会迫使克拉克下台。

en.t: 2019 Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council election
en.s: Elections to the Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council (KHADC) were held on 27 February 2019. The votes were counted on 2 March 2019 with the Indian National Congress emerging as the largest party in the council with 10 seats while the NPP and its ally UDP emerged as the ruling coalition with 7 and 6 seats respectively.

zh.t: 2019年卡西山区自治县议会选举
zh.s: 卡西山区自治县议会于2019年2月27日举行选举，3月2日计票。印度国民大会党获得10席，成为议会第一大党，但全国人民党及其盟友联合民主党分别获得7席和6席，组成执政联盟。

en.s: The Liberty Korea Party held a leadership election on 27 February 2019 to elect the next leader of the Liberty Korea Party for a new 2-year term. It was an election to succeed an interim leader Kim Byong-joon, who has been in office for about seven months since the defeat of the Liberty Korea Party in the local elections held on 13 June 2018.

zh.s: 自由韩国党于2019年2月27日选举新党魁，任期两年，接替临时领导人金秉准。该党在2018年6月13日地方选举中失利后，金秉准已临时主持党务约七个月。

en.t: 2019 Jaintia Hills Autonomous District Council election
en.s: Elections to the Jaintia Hills Autonomous District Council (JHADC) were held on 27 February 2019. The votes were counted on 2 March 2019 with the NPP emerging as the largest party alliance in the council with 12 and its ally UDP with 10 seats respectively.

zh.t: 2019年贾因蒂亚山区自治县议会选举
zh.s: 贾因蒂亚山区自治县议会于2019年2月27日举行选举，3月2日计票。全国人民党获得12席，成为第一大党，其盟友联合民主党获得10席，两党形成议会最大联盟。

en.s: On 27 February 2019, the Pakistan Air Force (PAF) conducted six airstrikes at multiple locations in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir (J&K). The airstrikes were part of the PAF military operation codenamed Operation Swift Retort and were conducted in retaliation to the Indian Air Force (IAF) airstrike in Balakot just a day before on 26 February.

zh.s: 2019年2月27日，巴基斯坦空军（PAF）在印度实际控制的查谟和克什米尔多地发动六次空袭。这些空袭属于巴基斯坦空军代号为“迅捷回击行动”的军事行动，是对印度空军前一天（2月26日）空袭巴拉科特的报复。

en.s: The 2020 Super ShowDown was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the third annual and final Super ShowDown and took place on Thursday, February 27, 2020, at the Mohammed Abdu Arena on the Boulevard in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and the main card aired at 8:00 p.m.

zh.s: “超级对决2020”是美国WWE公司举办的职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，参赛选手来自Raw和SmackDown两大主力品牌。这是第三届，也是最后一届年度“超级对决”。赛事于2020年2月27日星期四，在沙特阿拉伯利雅得林荫大道的穆罕默德·阿卜杜竞技场举行，正式节目于晚8点播出。

en.s: UFC Fight Night: Rozenstruik vs. Gane (also known as UFC Fight Night 186, UFC on ESPN+ 44 and UFC Vegas 20) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 27, 2021, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：罗森斯特鲁克对加恩
zh.s: “UFC格斗之夜：罗森斯特鲁克对加恩”，又称UFC格斗之夜186、UFC on ESPN+ 44及UFC拉斯维加斯20，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2021年2月27日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行。恩特普赖斯属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2021 Yobe State local elections were held on February 27, 2021, to elect 17 local government chairmen and 178 local government councillors in all 17 local government areas. As in the 2017 elections, the Yobe All Progressives Congress won all 17 chairmanship and 178 councillorship seats. Over one million voters were registered for the election in 1,714 polling units; voting in multiple units had to be relocated due to insecurity.

zh.s: 2021年2月27日，尼日利亚约贝州举行地方选举，选出全部17个地方政府区的主席和地方议员，席位分别为17席和178席。与2017年选举一样，全进步大会党赢得全部17个主席席位和178个议员席位。登记选民超过100万，投票设在1,714个投票站；由于安全局势不稳，多个投票站不得不迁址。

en.s: The 2022 EFL Cup final was the final of the 2021–22 EFL Cup. It was played between Chelsea and Liverpool at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 27 February 2022. The match saw no goals in the initial 90 minutes or the additional 30 minutes of extra time and went to a penalty shoot-out; each of the first 21 kicks in the shoot-out was scored before Chelsea goalkeeper Kepa Arrizabalaga missed his to give Liverpool an 11–10 victory and a record ninth EFL Cup title.

zh.s: 2021—22赛季英格兰联赛杯决赛，于2022年2月27日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由切尔西对阵利物浦。90分钟常规时间及30分钟加时均无进球，比赛进入点球大战。前21次罚球全部命中，随后切尔西门将凯帕·阿里萨瓦拉加罚失，利物浦以11比10获胜，创纪录地第九次夺得联赛杯。

en.s: On February 27, 2022, Urawa Red Diamonds Ladies defeated JEF United Chiba Ladies 1–0 in the final of the 2021 Empress’s Cup at Sanga Stadium in Kameoka, Japan.

zh.s: 2022年2月27日，浦和红钻女足在日本龟冈的京都桑加球场以1比0击败千叶市原女足，赢得2021年皇后杯冠军。

en.t: K-1 World GP 2022 Japan takes place in Tokyo
en.s: On February 27, 2022, K-1 staged its World GP 2022 Japan kickboxing event at Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.s: 2022年2月27日，K-1在日本东京体育馆举办世界大奖赛2022日本站踢拳赛事。

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Nagaland on 27 February 2023 to elect all 60 members of the Nagaland Legislative Assembly. The votes were counted and the results were declared on 2 March 2023. The election marked a historic moment as it saw the first-ever election of two female MLAs to the Nagaland Assembly.

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Meghalaya on 27 February 2023 to elect all 60 members of the Meghalaya Legislative Assembly. The votes were counted and the results were declared on 2 March 2023. The ruling NPP emerged as the single largest party and won 26 seats. It formed a government under the MDA.

zh.s: 印度梅加拉亚邦于2023年2月27日举行选举，改选邦议会全部60个议席，3月2日计票并公布结果。执政的全国人民党赢得26席，成为第一大党，并在梅加拉亚民主联盟框架下组建政府。

en.s: The 2024 Michigan Democratic presidential primary was held on February 27, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 117 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated in an open primary, with 21 additional unpledged delegates. The primary was pushed ahead into the early window of first states for the first time due to its diversity and relevance as a swing state on the recommendation of President Joe Biden.

zh.t: 2024年密歇根州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 密歇根州于2024年2月27日举行民主党总统初选，作为该党2024年总统候选人提名程序的一部分。开放式初选分配参加全国代表大会的117名代表，另有21名不受承诺约束的代表。因密歇根人口多元，又是重要摇摆州，在总统乔·拜登建议下，该州初选首次提前至最早一批州的投票时段。

en.s: The 2024 Tel Aviv municipal election was held on February 27, 2024. Originally scheduled for October 31, 2023, the elections were delayed due to the Gaza war to elect the mayor of Tel Aviv. The election was part of the 2024 Israeli municipal elections. Campaign issues included the increasing cost of living, the local real estate market and high housing costs, frequent traffic jams, the construction and delayed opening of the Tel Aviv Light Rail, and public transportation on Shabbat.

zh.s: 2024年2月27日，特拉维夫举行市政选举，选出市长。选举原定于2023年10月31日举行，因加沙战争而延期，也是2024年以色列市政选举的一部分。竞选议题包括生活成本上涨、当地房地产市场和高昂房价、频繁的交通拥堵、特拉维夫轻轨的建设及延期开通，以及安息日公共交通问题。

en.s: General elections were held on February 27, 2025, to elect the 124 members of the 44th Parliament of Ontario. Premier Doug Ford's Progressive Conservatives were re-elected to a third consecutive majority government, the first time a party has done so since 1959. The PCs increased their vote share to 43%, however lost three seats compared to 2022.

zh.s: 2025年2月27日，安大略省举行大选，选出第44届省议会的124名议员。省长道格·福特领导的进步保守党连续第三次赢得多数席位，这是自1959年以来首次有政党做到这一点。该党得票率升至43%，但与2022年相比少了三个席位。

en.s: The 2025 Liga Nusantara final was the final match of the 2024–25 Liga Nusantara, the 9th season of third-tier competition in Indonesia organised by PT Liga Indonesia Baru, and the inaugural season since it was renamed from the Liga 3 to the Liga Nusantara. en.t: Pakistan’s defence minister describes the conflict as “open war”
en.s: On February 27, 2026, Pakistan’s defence minister Khawaja Muhammad Asif said that Pakistan was in an “open war” with Afghanistan after overnight cross-border attacks. The statement marked an escalation in an existing conflict, rather than the first fighting between the countries.

zh.t: 巴基斯坦国防部长称与阿富汗已处于“公开战争”状态
